messages.subject: Re: how to get changed df to show up in a dataview
parts:
I forked and made some edits:
https://gist.github.com/4439972

By putting extra1 and extra2 into the server function, they inherit the proper scopes to access the per-user copy of mymtcars.

I should reiterate though that if the idea is to bring in extra data that is the SAME for all users (such as merging two static datasets) then you may as well do that outside the server function, otherwise you are doing exactly the same work every time for each new user.

messages.subject: Re: how to get changed df to show up in a dataview
parts:
I assume you think you need assign instead of <<- because the name will be dynamic? You can also use the function form of <<- which will let you use a dynamic name:

name <- "mymtcars"
`<<-`(name, value)   # note that these are backticks, not quotes
